assembly.name: Engine — short block (EA888 Gen 3)
assembly.description: EA888 Gen 3 short block: closed-deck grey cast iron block (82.5 mm bore × 92.8 mm stroke, 1,984 cc, firing order 1-3-4-2), forged flat-plane crankshaft on five 48 mm mains, cracked-cap rods, 9.3:1 pistons with electronically-controlled oil-jet cooling, and twin counter-rotating balance shafts at 2× crank speed. Bottom-end torque figures are tuner-reference values the dossier flags as indicative — verify against Bentley/erWin before any real work.

parts.name: Cylinder block (closed-deck, GJL 250)
parts.description: Closed-deck grey cast iron block (GJL 250), 82.5 mm bore × 92.8 mm stroke, upright-poured with 3.0 ± 0.5 mm nominal walls (dossier §2). The deck shows the four real bore openings; the chain drive runs at the flywheel end. The mechanical coolant pump is driven off a balance shaft, not the accessory belt.

parts.name: Main-bearing ladder frame
parts.description: Ladder frame tying the five main-bearing caps into one stiff structure under the crank.

torqueSpec.note: Indicative (alt published 60 Nm + 90°) — dossier flags bottom-end torques as tuner-reference; verify in Bentley/erWin

parts.name: Crankshaft (forged, 5 × 48 mm mains)
parts.description: Forged steel, induction-hardened crankshaft with four counterweights and five 48 mm main bearings (dossier §2). Flat-plane I4: pins 1+4 and 2+3 oppose, firing order 1-3-4-2. 92.8 mm stroke.

parts.name: Connecting rods, cracked-cap (36MnVS4) ×4
parts.description: 36MnVS4 rods with fracture-split (cracked) big-end caps — the split line is unique per rod, so caps are never interchangeable. Stock forged rods are documented to ~500 WHP (dossier §2, RWC). Torque shown is for the stretch-type rod bolts (replace after use).

torqueSpec.note: Rod bolts — stretch type, replace; indicative, verify in Bentley/erWin

parts.name: Pistons, 9.3:1 with oil-jet cooling ×4
parts.description: CJXB/CJXC-specific pistons for 9.3:1 compression (vs 9.6:1 GTI), Gen 3 strength-enhanced alloy coating, cooled by electronically-controlled oil jets with a higher flow rate on the R (dossier §2).

parts.name: Piston-cooling oil jets (electronically controlled) ×4
parts.description: Solenoid-controlled piston oil-jet cooling — a Gen 3 feature; the R runs a higher jet flow rate (dossier §2). One jet per bore, aimed up at the piston underside.

parts.name: Balance shaft, intake side
parts.description: Spheroidal graphite cast iron balance shaft on low-friction roller bearings, running at 2× crank speed to cancel second-order forces (dossier §2). This one also belt-drives the mechanical coolant pump.

parts.name: Balance shaft, exhaust side (counter-rotating)
parts.description: The second balance shaft; an idler gear reverses its rotation so the pair counter-rotate (dossier §2).
